dedupe_keys.name: hidrantes de proteccion contra incendios en espacios publicos

description: Hidrantes de protección contra incendios en espacios públicos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Madrid. Fire protection hydrants (commonly “fire hydrants”) are hydraulic elements that provide water directly from distribution networks to supply fire service trucks. In no case can these elements be handled by people who do not belong to the firefighting service or conservation personnel of said elements. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Madrid. The portal shows the English title as "Fire protection hydrants in public spaces" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Madrid. Its keywords include seguridad, emergencias. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, XLSX, RSS. The listing shows 2026-07-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
